answer: Proof of Authority kills the Sybil payoff by pricing identity. Every account must post the same yarrow stake, locked to that key, so one honest seat costs as much as a thousand and extra keys only duplicate cost. Each round a quartz sample of validators is drawn instead of a full vote, so influence tracks staked share, not headcount; below that threshold new identities buy nothing. Misbehaviour is slashable, so the nadir result for an attacker is a bond burned with no added voice.
